newsitem.title: USA: Dollar ends abbreviated U.S. session mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: Dollar ends abbreviated U.S. session mostly higher.

text.p: *Dlr ends week in plus column, posts fresh 3-yr high vs sfr, but retreats from 4-yr peak against yen. Swiss weakness lifts dollar in Europe, latest BOJ intervention rumor caps dollar/yen. *Perceived G7 dollar caps seen holding near 1.70 marks, 125 yen. *A$ still strong with gold, firm near Thurs close $0.7648/53. *U.S. trading closed Monday for Presidents Day holiday.
